decisions.skills: professional, tools, technologies, languages; no soft skills
decisions.training: future training and interest alone excluded
decisions.products: named product does not imply parent; industry is routing only
decisions.owner_sales_q1: Include named accounting software for explicit used OR sold alternatives; preserve condition. Selling alone does not imply using.
decisions.owner_sales_q2: Explicit skill heading such as office IT governs named tool list; company/system inventory alone stays ambiguous.
decisions.domain: Industry alone or generic domain experience does not prove domain knowledge; explicit knowledge or legal/brokerage duties required.
decisions.owner_real_estate_q1: An immediately adjacent closed CSKH/Sale/Telesale list may inherit an explicit experience predicate from the preceding sentence. Arbitrary tool inventories still unclear.
decisions.owner_real_estate_q2: Explicit experience managing sales or head of sales counts as sales; merely counting managed sales staff does not.
decisions.owner_real_estate_q3: Business law explicitly linked to the previous real-estate paragraph can count; conflicting legal sectors keep review; retain expanded source context.
decisions.owner_real_estate_q4: Preier means Premiere only in a clear creative-software list with Adobe/Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign context.
